title: GGT–alkaline-phosphatase interaction adds no established cross-cycle detection of unrecognized hyperglycemia
abstract: A frozen log-GGT × log-ALP interaction did not establish incremental detection of concurrent HbA1c ≥6.5% in adults without reported diabetes across independent NHANES cycles: target delta AUROC -0.000010, paired conditional 95% interval [-0.000069, +0.000046]. A bounded negative independent-sample predictive comparison, not a causal or clinical-utility claim.
